name: omnigraffle-tools
description: Editable OmniGraffle diagrams and genuine LaTeXiT LinkBack equations on macOS.

interface.longDescription: Create, inspect, update and export native OmniGraffle diagrams with a bounded local Python CLI. Equation editing uses official LaTeXiT and GUI automation on an unlocked Mac. Installation provides plugin files only; applications, TeX and permissions require explicit setup.
defaultPrompt: Use $omnigraffle-workflow to create an editable research diagram.
Inspect this .graffle and preserve its labels, palette and editable equations.
